data.name: Job
data.long_meaning: The name Job is derived from the Hebrew word ‘Iyov’, which means ‘perfect’ or ‘blameless’. In the biblical story, Job is a righteous man who is tested by God. Despite his suffering, he maintains his faith and is ultimately rewarded.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes unwavering faith and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.numerology_meaning: Indicates a powerful and self-sufficient individual, who is wise and experienced.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Job is a reminder of God's love, mercy, and patience. As a symbol of unwavering faith and endurance, Job's story teaches us that no matter what challenges we face in life, we can trust that God is with us and will ultimately bring good out of our suffering. It also encourages us to stay strong in our faith, maintain our hope, and have confidence in God's healing and redemptive power.
